compute_wer_cer: compute word error rate and character error rate for ASR predictions on mls, voxpopuli, fleurs-asr, or babel datasets
compute_bleu_score: compute BLEU score for speech-to-text translation evaluation on covost2 datasets using sacrebleu
compute_accuracy_f1: compute accuracy and macro F1 score for classification tasks on fleurs-lang_id or minds14 datasets
load_xtreme_s_metric: load the xtreme_s metric via evaluate.load with a config name like mls, covost2, or fleurs-lang_id
define_cer_transform: define a character-level CER transform pipeline using jiwer for old jiwer versions below 2.3.0
